_comment: Copy to cluster-controller.json and edit. The setup script reads this once. All fields have defaults; the minimum useful change is setting controller.hostname.

controller._comment: Identity. hostname is baked into the self-signed TLS cert SAN list and into Announcer responses.

db._comment: mode=nedb is the default for small deployments (no install, file-backed, fine up to a few hundred agents). Switch to mongodb for larger or higher-throughput clusters.

tls._comment: mode=self-signed (default) generates a fresh cert on first run. mode=import expects an operator-supplied PFX. mode=letsencrypt is a future opt-in (controller must be internet-reachable on 80).

meshcentral._comment: Override only what you must. Defaults are sane for a LAN-only single-controller deployment.

share._comment: SMB share that the host PCs pull the golden VHDX and agent .msh from. Read-only for Authenticated Users; full for Administrators.
share.name: ClusterShare

admin._comment: Initial admin user for the MeshCentral UI. Password is sourced from CLUSTERCTRL_ADMIN_PASS env var; if absent, the installer generates a secure random one and writes it to admin-bootstrap.txt with strict ACL.

firewall._comment: Which network profiles to open the controller ports on. Public is intentionally off by default — controllers should not be exposed to public WiFi.
